verification_note: Anthropic's Learn page links to Anthropic Academy and its Skilljar course catalog. Each included course page was checked for the Register | FREE marker. Use Batch Import with Refresh existing matches enabled and Provider ID set to prov-anthropic. Keep Preview only enabled first to review archive candidates before applying archive mode.

courses.title: Claude 101
courses.brief: An Anthropic Academy course on using Claude for everyday work tasks, core features, and next-step learning resources.
courses.long_description: Claude 101 introduces Claude fundamentals for everyday work, including core product features and guidance for moving into more advanced Claude learning.

courses.title: Claude Code 101
courses.brief: A beginner Anthropic Academy course on using Claude Code effectively in a daily development workflow.
courses.long_description: Claude Code 101 introduces Claude Code for developers, covering practical setup and workflow patterns for using Claude Code in day-to-day engineering work.

courses.title: Claude Platform 101
courses.brief: A beginner course for developers learning to build on the Claude Developer Platform from the ground up.
courses.long_description: This Anthropic Academy course introduces the Claude Developer Platform for learners who may have made only a few API calls or used Claude through a chat window.

courses.title: Introduction to Claude Cowork
courses.brief: A hands-on course on working with Claude Cowork across real files, projects, plugins, skills, and research workflows.
courses.long_description: This Anthropic Academy course covers the Cowork task loop, plugins and skills, file and research workflows, and practical steering patterns for responsible multi-step work.

courses.title: Claude Code in Action
courses.brief: An Anthropic Academy course on integrating Claude Code into an effective developer workflow.
courses.long_description: Claude Code in Action focuses on practical development workflows and productivity patterns for using Claude Code in software engineering work.

courses.title: AI Fluency: Framework & Foundations
courses.brief: An Anthropic Academy course on collaborating with AI effectively, efficiently, ethically, and safely.
courses.long_description: AI Fluency: Framework & Foundations introduces a practical framework for working with AI systems responsibly and effectively across common contexts.

courses.title: Building with the Claude API
courses.brief: A developer course covering the full spectrum of working with Anthropic models through the Claude API.
courses.long_description: Building with the Claude API is a comprehensive Anthropic Academy course for developers integrating Anthropic models through API-based workflows.

courses.title: Introduction to Model Context Protocol
courses.brief: A developer course on building Model Context Protocol servers and clients using Python.
courses.long_description: This Anthropic Academy course teaches MCP's core primitives, tools, resources, and prompts, and shows how to connect Claude with external services.

courses.title: AI Fluency for Educators
courses.brief: An AI fluency course for faculty, instructional designers, and educational leaders applying AI in teaching practice.
courses.long_description: AI Fluency for Educators helps education professionals apply AI fluency to teaching practice, instructional design, and institutional strategy.

courses.title: AI Fluency for Students
courses.brief: An AI fluency course for students using responsible AI collaboration to support learning, career planning, and academic success.
courses.long_description: AI Fluency for Students helps learners develop responsible AI collaboration habits for study, academic work, and career planning.

courses.title: Model Context Protocol: Advanced Topics
courses.brief: An advanced MCP course covering production implementation patterns including sampling, notifications, file system access, and transports.
courses.long_description: Model Context Protocol: Advanced Topics covers advanced MCP implementation patterns for production server development.

courses.title: Claude with Amazon Bedrock
courses.brief: An Anthropic Academy course on following Claude training originally created for AWS accreditation.
courses.long_description: Claude with Amazon Bedrock covers practical model use and integration patterns for Claude through AWS Bedrock.

courses.title: Claude with Google Cloud's Vertex AI
courses.brief: A developer course on working with Anthropic models through Google Cloud's Vertex AI.
courses.long_description: Claude with Google Cloud's Vertex AI covers the full spectrum of working with Anthropic models through Vertex AI.

courses.title: Teaching AI Fluency
courses.brief: A course for faculty, instructional designers, and others teaching and assessing AI fluency in instructor-led settings.
courses.long_description: Teaching AI Fluency helps educators and instructional teams teach, assess, and operationalize AI fluency in instructor-led environments.

courses.title: AI Fluency for Nonprofits
courses.brief: An AI fluency course for nonprofit professionals focused on increasing impact and efficiency while staying mission-aligned.
courses.long_description: AI Fluency for Nonprofits helps nonprofit professionals develop practical AI fluency for responsible organizational impact and workflow improvement.

courses.title: Introduction to agent skills
courses.brief: A Claude Code course on building, configuring, sharing, and troubleshooting reusable agent skills.
courses.long_description: Introduction to agent skills teaches how to create reusable markdown instructions that Claude can apply to the right tasks at the right time.

courses.title: Introduction to subagents
courses.brief: A Claude Code course on using and creating subagents to manage context, delegate tasks, and build specialized workflows.
courses.long_description: This Anthropic Academy course explains how subagents can keep a main conversation clean and focused while delegating work to specialized workflows in Claude Code.

courses.title: AI Capabilities and Limitations
courses.brief: An introductory Anthropic Academy course explaining how AI works and where its capabilities and limits matter.
courses.long_description: This course introduces core ideas about AI capabilities and limitations so learners can reason more clearly about what AI systems can and cannot do.

courses.title: AI Fluency for Small Businesses
courses.brief: An AI fluency course for small businesses focused on increasing impact and efficiency while preserving mission and judgment.
courses.long_description: This Anthropic Academy course helps small business teams develop practical AI fluency for responsible collaboration, productivity, and organizational impact.

courses.title: AI Fluency for Builders
courses.brief: An AI fluency course for builders focused on increasing impact and efficiency while owning the full arc from problem to shipped solution.
courses.long_description: This Anthropic Academy course helps builders develop AI fluency for responsible, effective collaboration with AI across the full path from problem framing to shipped work.
